Phase one · Goes live first

The marketing website

The public, front-facing website: phase one, and the first thing we take live. Real content from deeprootsbible.com, with sign-up and contact forms that feed straight into the portal.

  • Home · Why · Curriculum (K–6 aligned, gaps marked “coming soon”)
  • Testimonials · FAQ + site search · Resources · Shop & checkout · Events · Contact
  • Sign-up and contact forms feed the Marketing section
Access · Sign-in

Secure staff sign-in

Only invited staff can get in. They sign in with a one-time link or a 6-digit code, and an approved-email list controls who has access.

Staff portal · Workflows

Workflows: the “pizza-tracker” engine

Every process runs as a simple step-by-step tracker (think pizza tracker) that nudges the next person automatically, across onboarding, offboarding, hiring, and new-school sign-ups.

Workflow hand-offs

The relay between departments: when one workflow finishes it hands the baton to the next, so work crosses teams without falling through the cracks.

Part two

The School Portal

The third surface, a Salesforce-powered directory and rich, self-serve pages for every partner school.

School Portal · Directory

Schools directory

A Salesforce-powered directory that separates schools still being set up from active customers, with a state filter and a rooftop map.

Live from Salesforce Onboarding & Active
School Portal · onboarding

Schools in onboarding

Schools working through setup with the DeepRoots team, each with a live progress tracker; when onboarding completes, a school moves to Active.

Per-school tracker Illustrative
School Portal · School page

The school page

A rich per-school profile: every teacher and admin you can contact right here, analytics on who’s logging into the curriculum, the school logo and tiered partner badge, a rooftop map, financial history from Salesforce, and a rotating social spotlight.

Partner tiers · Bronze to NavyPlanned from Salesforce

Behind the scenes · One platform

All your tools, working together

Today the team juggles many separate tools, moving documents and data around the cloud by hand to keep customers happy. The new platform brings those tools together, so information flows on its own and people spend their time on customers, not on shuffling files between apps.

Behind the scenes · Foundation

Data foundation & automation

One secure database under everything, refreshed on a schedule, with a clear “last updated” stamp on every section.

  • Real data only, anything illustrative is clearly labeled.
  • Each person sees only what they should; passwords in a secure vault.

What we’d build · Assistant

A DeepRoots helper that knows who you are

A built-in helper that answers questions and guides each person by their role. Sign in as a teacher and it points you to lesson help; as a new employee, straight to the Employee Handbook and where to find things.

  • Teacher: “How do I reset a student login?”
  • New hire: “Where is the Employee Handbook?”
  • Sales Ambassador: “Which schools are due to renew?”

Status & roadmap

Where it stands and what’s next

You can click through every screen, but this is early: what’s live today is mostly mockups, not real data yet. The build ahead is what makes each area real.

  • Started: ~10% complete; only the mockups are live so far.
  • Next: a ~10-week build to connect the real data sources.
  • Roadmap: Pre-K → finish 8th grade → churches → self-taught path.
